title: An old category matrix called General Matrix gets (old) added
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, have a category matrix named General Matrix in any capitals (matrix A), for category A.
  • Use the same client after the deploy.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click General Matrix (old) on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the renamed default matrix as General Matrix, with the Default badge.
  • Matrix A is listed as "General Matrix (old)" in its own capitals.

Step 2:

  • Its Categories line names category A.
  • Its rules are the rules matrix A had before the deploy.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
